distinguisher: The generated text is not runnable at all, rather than runnable with a different result. A reviewer fixes it by naming a function that exists; the value-divergence type needs a semantic decision instead.
note: Cheap for a rule to catch as well, and recorded as its own type precisely so that the expensive semantic type is not diluted by it. findings/42 scored this one low for that reason while noting that missing it would still be bad.

title: A lowered expression names a function the target dialect does not define
